problem:
Which of the following are square matrices?

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -10 & 0.5 \\ -2 & 0\end{aligned}],\,S=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,T=[\begin{aligned}1.5 & -3 & 0 & 1 & 9 \\ 0 & 0.2 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \sqrt{3} & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 & 0 & 6 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 & 5 & 8\end{aligned}]\,
$$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following are square matrices?

$$
K=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 0 & \sqrt{2}\end{aligned}],\,L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 5 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
- $K$ is a square matrix since it has the same number of rows and columns. It has $2$ rows and $2$ columns, so it is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

- $L$ is *not* a square matrix since the numbers of rows and columns are not the same. It has $1$ rows and $2$ columns, so it's a $1\times 2$ matrix.

- $M$ is *not* a square matrix since the numbers of rows and columns are not the same. It has $4$ rows and $3$ columns, so it's a $4\times 3$ matrix.

Therefore, only $K$ is a square matrix.
